d: Poland's Prime Minister Donald Tusk has accused Russia of 'planning' an attack on NATO that could be carried out this Winter. The accusation comes after repeated Russian drone incursions into NATO airspace. This week, Poland and Lithuania reported Russian drone violations. As per Poland, the Gerbera-2 Russian drone was found with an explosive strapped to it. The Gerbera-2 is a low-cost, lightweight drone that is increasingly being used by Russia to fool NATO's radars. Meanwhile, Italy scrambled its Eurofighter Typhoon to shoot down a Russian drone that had entered Lithuania this week.…
